subject: ERROR: Key / already in use, deployApp runs but no app shows

messages.author: 53626e29c26886b6
messages.subject: ERROR: Key / already in use, deployApp runs but no app shows
parts:
I have previously successfully deployed Apps. Today I deployed another app and the process all ran fine but:

- when I got to the app url I got: "ERROR: Key / already in use" message in the browser and no app showing. In ShinyApps dashboard it shows as "Running".

Here's what I've tried so far:

In RStudio, remove account, then reinput the 

shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name='...', token='...', secret='<SECRET>') (obviously including the relevant name, token and secret).

before then re-running deployApp(account = '...')

I've tried adding a token, repeating the process above, same problem.

I have just taken a second account out for work, not sure if that's part of the problem or a co-incidence, but the problem is now on both accounts.

Any ideas?
